payload.name: Redesign messenger Discord+TG
payload.description: Переделать интерфейс мессенджера в приложении NotOC так, чтобы он был похож на Discord + Telegram. Сохранить существующую систему светлой/тёмной темы. Изменение только CSS без изменения React-логики.

goal.answer: Redesign the messenger interface to combine Telegram layout (sidebar chat list + chat area) with Discord flat message style (avatar + name + text, no bubbles). Keep both light/dark themes functional. Minimal JSX changes allowed for avatar/name rendering in messages.

payload.plain: Redesign the messenger interface to combine Telegram layout (sidebar chat list + chat area) with Discord flat message style (avatar + name + text, no bubbles). Keep both light/dark themes functional. Minimal JSX changes allowed for avatar/name rendering in messages.

criteria.answer:
Rail is minimal (~44px), no background/border, circular avatars only
Conversations panel styled like Telegram — flat list with message previews, subtle dividers
Messages are Discord-style flat list with sender avatar, nickname, text, and timestamp (no bubble backgrounds)
Message bubbles removed as a visual concept (no border-radius backgrounds, floating shadows)
Composer styled like Discord — minimal, attached to bottom, subtle borders
Chat header is clean (avatar + nickname + status only)
Friends/requests view styled consistently with the clean aesthetic
Both light and dark themes render correctly
Client builds successfully (`npm run build`)
Messenger functionality preserved (sending, receiving, editing, deleting, image uploads)

phaseSnapshots.name: Redesign messenger Discord+TG
phaseSnapshots.goal: Transform messenger layout and styling to Telegram+Discord hybrid aesthetic

steps.description: Redesign layout: narrow rail (~44px, no bg), widen conversations panel for Telegram-style chat list, adjust chat panel proportions
Style conversations panel like Telegram: flat list items, subtle dividers between chats, preview text styling, remove rounded card backgrounds
Add sender avatar/nickname to message JSX in MessengerWindow.tsx, then style messages as Discord flat list (no bubble bg/radius, avatar+name+text+timestamp layout)
Style composer, chat header, and friends view to match clean Discord/Telegram aesthetic
Build client workspace to confirm no TypeScript or Vite errors

assumptions.answer: MessengerWindow.tsx message render can add sender avatar/nickname without changing state logic; CSS in styles.css (both blocks ~1528-1850 and ~2519-3415) must be kept in sync for responsive/desktop views; Current friends data and message data flow remain unchanged; User accent color (--blue) stays configurable but should be used very sparingly in the new design

payload.summary: Transformed messenger UI to a Telegram+Discord hybrid aesthetic across all 5 steps: (1) Layout redesigned with minimal 48px rail and tighter gaps, (2) Conversations panel restyled as Telegram flat list with bottom dividers and left accent bars, (3) Messages converted to Discord-style flat list with sender avatar and nickname added via minimal JSX changes, (4) Composer, header, friends view, and tabs flattened with subtle borders instead of pills/panels, (5) Build passes with zero errors. Zero gradients remain in messenger/message selectors. Both light and dark themes are preserved via CSS variables.

payload.finalSummary:
Successfully redesigned the NotOC messenger interface to a Telegram+Discord hybrid aesthetic. All changes preserve existing light/dark theme switching and app functionality.

Key changes:
- **Layout:** Narrowed rail to 48px with transparent background, circular avatars with Discord-style left active pill; tightened gaps throughout
- **Conversations panel:** Flat Telegram-style list with bottom dividers instead of cards; active item shows left accent bar; removed all border-radius from panel/items
- **Message list (Discord-style):** Sender avatar (36px circular) + nickname + timestamp row above message text/image; all messages span full width; subtle hover highlight; no bubble backgrounds or border-radius
- **Composer:** Removed backdrop-filter/blur, flat background, compact input
- **Chat header:** Removed border-radius, flat with clean border-bottom
- **Friends view:** Removed pill-shaped tabs → flat bottom-border tabs; flattened cards/panels (zero border-radius)
- **Build:** Client compiles and bundles successfully (`npm run build` in 1.54s)

Minimal JSX changes made in `MessengerWindow.tsx` to render `message-avatar` and `message-author` with correct sender data. All other logic (state, sockets, API) is untouched.

grade.rationale: F1 steps 1-4 relied on grep-based string matching to verify CSS changes, and C1 criterion 10 confirmed messenger functionality preservation solely through static inspection of unchanged MessengerWindow.tsx logic rather than runtime execution of sending, receiving, or editing. While `npm run build` provided genuine artifact compilation (F1 step 5), the heavy dependence on proxy verification for load-bearing visual and functional claims keeps this from a strict A.
